nodes.label: Multi-Model NIM Gateway
nodes.rationale: Routes turns to primary, fast, or fallback profiles with automatic retry on 5xx/429.

nodes.label: Payment Verification Barrier
nodes.rationale: Agents never mark payments paid or verified; human staff must verify all banking/M-Pesa claims.

nodes.label: Three-Layer Agent Architecture
nodes.rationale: Separates omnichannel ingestion, RBAC policy/prompting, and multi-model tool execution.

nodes.label: Five-Role Agent Workforce
nodes.rationale: Specializes capabilities: Manager for owner/dashboard, Sales for conversion, Support for tickets, Booking for calendar, Orders for fulfillment.

nodes.label: Strict Zero-Hallucination Guardrails
nodes.rationale: Mandates tool calls before answering prices, hours, or availability, logging knowledge gaps on unknowns.

nodes.label: Agent QA Evaluation Framework
nodes.rationale: Captures turn telemetry, human labelling (ok/needs_improvement/bug), and exports JSONL eval datasets.

nodes.label: Supabase Multi-Tenant RLS Isolation
nodes.rationale: Guarantees tenant isolation at the PostgreSQL database level using RLS and app_tenant_id JWT claim.

nodes.label: Agent Turn Reasoning Loop
nodes.rationale: Orchestrates max 5 tool rounds with anti-repetition penalty, stop sequences, and text sanitization.

nodes.label: Shwari Manager Executive Assistant
nodes.rationale: Owner-facing operational bot that configures products, services, opening hours, and metrics.
